facts.text: Through the Pine Tree State Pledge tuition guarantee program, eligible entering in-state, full-time first-year students pay no out-of-pocket expenses for tuition and mandatory fees.

sources.title: Pine Tree State Pledge - University of Maine at Augusta
sources.quote: Through this tuition guarantee program, qualified and eligible entering in-state, full-time first-year students will not pay any out-of-pocket expenses for tuition (regular UMA tuition) and mandatory fees.
